pages.text:
Chickxel terms used in this guide and what they mean. Click a term to open the page that explains it. In the guide text, the first mention of a term on each page links to the same place.
Term Meaning
9-slice A Unity sprite border that splits an image into nine parts so its corners stay crisp when stretched.
account level (level chip) Your Chickxel account's level, which rises with the XP you earn by sharing and shows as an Lv chip next to your name.
active palette The palette you last clicked or edited; Edit-menu and AI palette tools use it.
Add range The effect range given to effects newly added in the effects dialog.
AI chat The window where you ask Claude or Codex to edit the drawing.
AI references (reference library) A library of images, notes and rules on your computer that the AI looks through before drawing.
AI Status window (AI Status and Settings) The window that checks CLI installation, version, sign-in and MCP connection, and installs or signs in.
AI tools (MCP tools) The editor functions Chickxel exposes over MCP for the AI to read and edit the image.
allowing scripts to run (allowed to run) Deciding that a script effect you haven't seen before may run on this computer.
animated effect (animated effects) An effect that changes over its effect range (flash, shake, explode and so on).
app trash Chickxel's own trash that keeps deleted files and old export outputs for a while.
apply effect permanently (apply permanently, applied permanently) Bakes an effect into the cel pixels and removes it from the effect list.
Asset Manager The window for installing, importing and publishing assets such as effects and gradients.
auto layout A group setting that lines its parts up by size and re-lines them up whenever the parts change.
Auto optimize Searches each checked preset for the highest-scoring values of the steps that have Optimize on.
autosave Saves automatically after a short pause.
base position The part position shared by all frames; per-frame distances are added to it.
brush shape (brush size) The shape (square, circle, diamond) and size (1–32) that brush tools such as the pencil and eraser paint at once.
candidate tile (candidate row) A tile in the Pixelate window showing one preset's result and score; click to select it, double-click to apply it.
canvas The central area where you view the current frame and draw.
canvas pivot The canvas's own pivot used for sheet and Unity exports; with a representative layer it follows that layer's pivot.
canvas size mode A mode for setting the new canvas size and image position directly on the canvas.
cel (cels) The drawing of one layer in one frame — a single timeline cell.
cell name (cell names) The sprite name of each sheet cell (by frame number or by tag).
Chickxel account The chickxel.com account used for gallery and asset uploads (sign in with Google, GitHub or Discord).
Choose help on screen (help picker) Press F1, then click a button or panel on screen to open its guide page.
Claude Code Anthropic's command-line AI tool. Signed in with a Claude subscription, it powers the Claude tab of AI chat.
clipping (clip to effect above) A setting that applies an effect only to the pixels made by the effect above it.
Codex CLI OpenAI's command-line AI tool. Signed in with a ChatGPT subscription, it powers the Codex tab and image generation.
color decision The row in the enlarged view that shows how one pixel's color was decided at each step.
color distance How closeness between two colors is measured (OKLCh hue-weighted, CIEDE2000, OKLab), used when cells pick palette colors.
color picker The panel that sets the color being edited with a square, honeycomb, wheel or sliders.
color space The color model used to blend a smooth gradient (RGB, HSL, OKLab, OKLCH).
Contiguous only A setting that limits fill and the magic wand to the area connected to the clicked pixel.
convert to palette colors Replaces the image's colors with the nearest palette colors.
copy images only (images-only copy, images-only copies) Copies timeline cels or frames as images only without their link groups.
Current file only A chat toggle that limits the AI to the image open when you send.
display language The language of menus, windows and messages; changing it takes effect after a restart.
dithering Mixing two colors in a dot pattern so they read as an in-between color; used by the dithering tool, gradients and palette conversion.
document tab (document tabs) A tab above the canvas for each open document.
Dodge/burn (Lighten/darken) A tool that rubs painted pixels lighter (left button) or darker (right button).
Draw pixels directly A drawing mode where the AI places pixels one by one with the pixel tools.
Drawing settings (drawing settings) The chat panel that sets the drawing mode and generation options.
easing How an animated effect speeds up and slows down over its range.
Effect Maker The window for writing, previewing and publishing script effects.
effect padding The space an effect reserves outside the image to draw in (outline thickness, shadow offset and so on).
effect preset (effect presets) Several effects and their values saved together under a name.
effect range (effect ranges) The frames an effect applies to: all frames or a start–end frame.
effect row (effect rows, effect box) The row each effect gets under its layer in the timeline, with a box showing its range.
effects dialog The dialog for adding effects to one layer, changing their order, settings and ranges, and previewing them.
end chick The chick shown on the last frame of a transform effect's preview.
enlarged preview A resizable window that plays the preview enlarged.
eraser A tool that erases pixels to transparent (or by a strength and channels).
error log (error logs) Files describing unexpected errors; the latest 20 are kept in Logs in the settings folder.
excluded color (excluded colors) Removing one color from the selected result, replacing its pixels with the nearest remaining color.
Export as animated GIF The dialog that makes a single GIF for sharing.
export cell name (export cell names, cell naming rule) The name of a cell (Unity sprite) in an exported sheet, set per frame or generated by the naming rule.
Export dialog The dialog that sets up frame sheet and part atlas PNGs and Unity settings.
export on save The export dialog setting that creates the outputs (images, meta files) whenever you save; on for new projects.
export path encryption Writing a project file's export folder and names locked with this install's own key (local-path-key.bin), so others can't see your folder paths.
export preset (export presets) Named export settings you can reuse in other projects.
Extend frames An effects dialog setting that adds frames to an effect's range to create animation frames.
external AI connection A setting that lets other AI apps use the running Chickxel's editor tools through Chickxel --mcp.
eyedropper A tool that picks a canvas color into the primary or secondary color.
fast path The execution path that converts and compiles a script's source to run it fast.
ffmpeg An external program used to open videos, AVIF and HEIC files; it isn't bundled with Chickxel and must be installed separately.
Fidelity The largest score term, measuring how closely the result matches the background-removed source cells.
file association The OS registration that makes double-clicking a .chickxel in Explorer or Finder open Chickxel.
file browser The left panel that shows a folder's images as thumbnails and opens them.
first skin (base skin) The skin at the front of a group's skin list; it uses the plain cell names in the part atlas.
Fit outline to 1 px How a thick outer outline becomes 1 px: By shrinking, Thin outline only, Redraw as vector or Off.
fit to window Switches to the largest zoom that fits the whole image in the canvas area.
floating selection Selected pixels that were lifted or pasted and not yet dropped.
frame (frames) One picture of the animation: a timeline column with its own duration (ms).
frame duration How long one frame is shown (ms).
frame header (frame headers) The frame number cell in the timeline's top row; click it to select the frame.
frame sheet A PNG with every frame laid out in a grid.
frame split The step that splits a source with several frames into one frame each.
Generate image → pixelate A drawing mode that makes a picture with Codex image generation and converts it to pixel art.
gradient pencil A pencil that paints along the stroke in gradient colors.
gradient preset (gradient presets) A gradient saved under a name with its stops, interpolation, color space and dithering.
gradient stop (color stop, opacity stop) A point on the gradient bar that sets which color (or opacity) sits at which position.
gradient tool A tool that paints a linear gradient by dragging.
grid detection Finding how many source pixels make one "pixel" and where the cell boundaries are.
group layer (group layers) A layer that bundles part layers into one character.
group view The canvas state with a group selected, where you see the frame composite and drag parts into place.
guide window The in-app window for searching and browsing this guide (Help > Guide…).
hue shift A shading method that turns the hue toward yellow when lightening and toward blue/purple when darkening (the default lighten/darken mode).
image chip (image chips) The marker for an attached image inside the message text: a thumbnail and a #number.
Import Settings The Unity Texture Importer settings written to the .meta file.
Import video The window that extracts a video into frames after you set the range, frame rate and size.
keep the end look Keeps an animated effect's final appearance on frames after its range.
keyboard shortcut (keyboard shortcuts) Keys that run a command directly; you can change them in Preferences.
language folder The Languages folder in the settings folder where added languages and edited text are stored.
lasso select (lasso) A selection tool that selects the inside of an outline you draw.
layer (layers) One sheet you paint on. It is a timeline row; upper layers cover lower ones.
layer colors The colors used in every frame of the current layer, most used first.
layer effect (layer effects) Effects such as outline, shadow or flash that are layered on without changing the pixels.
layer pivot (layer pivots) The pivot a normal layer or group has, measured against the canvas; that layer's effects, transform rotation center and symmetry axis use it.
linked cels (cel link) A link that makes several cels share one drawing; editing one changes them all.
linked copy (linked copies) Copying timeline cels together with their link groups, so cels pasted into the same row join the original group.
local cell correction Re-fits the image-wide cell lines band by band to the real color edges.
locked layer (locked layers) A layer locked with the timeline padlock so that drawing and AI edits can't change it.
magic wand A selection tool that selects the area of similar color around the click (same settings as Fill).
main preset The preset used to pixelate images generated by AI drawing.
MCP Model Context Protocol, the connection the AI CLI uses to call Chickxel's editor tools.
merge files Combines several images selected in the file browser into one .chickxel.
meta file (meta files) The Unity settings file (.meta) next to an exported image, holding sprite cells, pivots and the guid.
middle fill Chooses whether the middle is stretched (Stretch) or its pattern repeated (Tile) when stretching with 9-slice.
move pivot along Moves the center (pivot) of later effects by as much as a moving effect moved the image.
Move tool The tool that moves the selection or the whole cel; Ctrl turns any tool into it while held.
my assets Assets made on this computer or published with your account; you edit them in place.
nearest neighbor A scaling and rotation method that uses the nearest original pixel without blending colors.
New project dialog The dialog that creates a new document from a canvas size, start mode and background.
number field (number fields) A field you change by clicking to type, using the up/down buttons at its right end, or picking from its right-click list.
official effect (official effects) The 23 script effects the app installs by default (Outline, Shadow, Hit flash and so on).
onion skin A view option that overlays neighboring frames translucently.
Optimize criteria The per-preset budget (trials, seconds) and scoring rules for Clean up and Auto optimize.
outfit (outfit preset) The combination of skins chosen per group and part; it can be saved as a preset.
outfit row The row below the preview where you pick a skin for each group.
palette A list of colors to paint with. You can stack several and switch between them.
palette web (Lospec) A window for browsing and importing palettes from lospec.com.
part atlas A PNG that packs part drawings one per cell.
part layer (part layers) A layer with its own size inside a group (head, body and so on).
part override (part overrides) A choice that dresses a single part in a different skin than its group.
part pivot The pivot of a part's atlas sprite, measured against the part size.
part view The canvas state with a part selected, showing only that part at its own size with the rest dimmed.
part-only skin (part-only skins) A skin that exists for one part only (e.g. a hat for Head), worn only as that part's override.
peek previous frame Shows the previous frame on the canvas while the key is held.
pencil The basic drawing tool that paints pixels in the brush shape.
per-frame part position (per-frame part positions) A part placement that differs from the base position in a particular frame.
per-frame pivot A pivot (and for parts, position) kept separately from a given frame to the end with 'From current frame on'.
pick from screen A color popup button that picks a color anywhere on the screen, other apps included.
ping-pong A tag direction that plays to the end and back.
pinned color (pinned colors) A color picked from a source cell and added to the result palette; only pixels closer to it change.
pivot The reference point for rotation and placement, exported as the Unity sprite pivot.
Pivot tool The tool for setting the pivot by dragging on the canvas or with buttons and numbers.
pixel font (pixel fonts) A font drawn on a pixel grid; Galmuri, Unifont and others come with the app.
pixel grid A view option that outlines every pixel when zoomed in.
pixel perfect An option that removes the doubled L-shaped pixels at stair corners when drawing at size 1, leaving a one-pixel line.
Pixel steps A setting that joins the pixels of shape lines and curves, or of pencil, gradient pencil and eraser strokes, diagonally (Diagonal) or only sideways and up/down (Orthogonal); the Shape tool and the pencil remember it separately.
Pixelate AI image (Pixelate) The window that turns AI-made or large images into clean pixel art.
pixels outside the canvas Pixels pushed past the canvas edge. They are kept and can be brought back.
Prefer shade family Prefers a palette color of the cell's own hue family over a different hue of similar lightness.
preset parameter (preset parameters) A value in an effect preset that changes settings of several effects inside it together.
preview chick The 20 numbered chick pictures that effect and preset previews apply the effect to.
preview position and pivot Declaration values that move the end chick and each frame's pivot in effect previews.
preview scene A small drawing used with the chick to preview effects that read other layers.
preview tab A green-tinted tab that plays the document being edited, enlarged, in the other pane.
primary color (Primary) The color painted with the left mouse button.
project file (project files) The .chickxel file that holds everything you edit: layers, frames, effects, export settings and more.
publish online The window that publishes one of your assets to the Store and chickxel.com with your Chickxel account.
question card The card with options that appears above the input box when the AI asks you to decide.
received assets (received asset) Assets by others from the Store or files; copy one to My assets to change it.
recent colors The last 16 colors you painted with, newest first.
recent files The list of the last 10 opened or saved files, in the File menu and on the start screen.
recovery file (recovery files) A .chickxel saved separately for an unsaved document when an error forces the app to quit.
Replace color brush (color replace brush) A brush that, where you rub, changes only the color of the pixel where the stroke started.
representative layer The layer whose pivot the canvas pivot follows in every frame (crown before its name).
resampling How rotated or scaled pixels take their colors from the original (RotSprite / Nearest).
Revert to saved A command that discards unsaved edits and rereads the file from disk.
Right button = eraser An option that makes the right button of the pencil, gradient pencil, shape and fill tools erase instead of using the secondary color.
rotation center The point transform mode and Transform whole layer rotate around; it starts at the current layer's pivot.
RotSprite A pixel-art rotation method that samples an 8× enlarged copy so rotated lines break less (no new colors).
score term (score breakdown) The terms, such as Fidelity and 1-px outline, and their weights that make up a candidate's 0–100 score.
script API The declaration, settings, img, ctx and other names and rules used in a script effect's source.
script effect (script effects) An effect written in JavaScript.
secondary color (Secondary) The color painted with the right mouse button (it erases when Right button = eraser is on).
seed A number that fixes the look of a random effect; the same seed always gives the same look.
selection The area chosen with a selection tool; painting, erasing and moving stay inside it.
settings folder (app settings folder) The Chickxel folder holding preferences, undo history, the app trash and logs (%AppData%\Chickxel on Windows).
shape pen (shape set) A drawing tool that stamps small pictures (leaves, flowers, sparkles and more) from the chosen set. You can add shapes to a set or share it as a file.
Shape tool A tool that drags out 11 shapes such as lines, curves, rectangles, ellipses and stars.
show effects on canvas A view option that decides whether layer effects are shown on the editing canvas.
skin (skins) One set of drawings for the same part structure (outfit, body type and so on).
skin chip (skin chips) The small label after a group or part name in the timeline showing the skin worn; click it to open the skin manager.
skin manager The window that shows every group's skins and the outfit presets as cards for editing.
skin slot (skin slots) The place skins are swapped in, i.e. a group. Skins in one slot replace each other; slots stack.
split view The canvas divided into left and right panes showing two documents.
Sprite Library The .spriteLib asset Unity uses to swap skins.
start screen The screen shown with no document open, where you choose a folder, recent file or Unity Hub project.
status bar The bottom line showing coordinates, color, size and save state.
style rules The pixel-art rules the AI follows when drawing: the built-in rules plus your own rules.md.
symmetry drawing (horizontal symmetry, vertical symmetry) An option that also draws on the opposite side of the canvas center (or pivot) axis.
tag (tags) A named frame range that groups an animation (for example idle or run).
target colors A color count above which (or, when Strict, below which) the score is reduced.
temporary MCP config The MCP server address and token Chickxel passes straight to the CLI on each run, separate from your CLI settings.
text box A text area dragged out with the Text tool; lines wrap within its width.
the Store (Store tab) The Asset Manager tab for finding and installing effects and gradients published on chickxel.com.
tile grid A view option that draws a line every tile of the chosen size.
tiled mode A view option that repeats the image around itself to check seamless patterns.
timeline The bottom panel that shows frames (columns) and layers (rows) as cels.
tolerance How different a color may be and still count as the same for fill and magic wand.
tool line (tool lines) A chat line showing an editor tool the AI called, its result and how long it took.
Tool options (tool options) The right-dock panel where you change the current tool's settings.
toolbar The vertical bar on the far left for picking tools.
top bar The bar below the menus with the tool name, view options and zoom.
transform mode A mode for rotating, scaling and moving the selected pixels with handles.
transform whole layer A mode that rotates, scales, moves and distorts every frame of one layer (every skin of a part) together with one orange box.
translation CSV A spreadsheet file with every UI string as a key and one column per language; add a column to make a new language.
undo history Undo steps that survive closing and reopening a file.
Undo this step The button under an AI reply that undoes everything that reply changed.
update dialog (automatic update) The dialog that shows a new version and its changes, then downloads, installs and restarts.
Upload to gallery The window that uploads a picture to the chickxel.com gallery.
Use palette colors only A drawing setting that snaps the colors the AI paints to the nearest color in the current palette.
wrap around A Move tool option that brings pixels pushed off one side back on the other side.
XP Points from gallery pictures, shared assets, likes, daily check-ins and app time that raise your account level.
zoom level How much the canvas is magnified (1–64×, whole steps).
